lyrics.ja: 星の数だけほら　選択肢があったって story
lyrics.romaji: Hoshi no Kazu Dake Hora Sentakushi ga Atta tte Story
lyrics.en: Look—there were as many choices as stars, yet in this story
lyrics.zh: 你看，即使有繁星般眾多的選擇，story

lyrics.ja: 君の書いた夢に　出会えたキセキ感じて
lyrics.romaji: Kimi no Kaita Yume ni Deaeta Kiseki Kanjite
lyrics.en: I feel the miracle of having met the dream you wrote
lyrics.zh: 感受到與你寫下的夢想相遇的奇蹟

lyrics.ja: 北の空　7つの星　輝いて
lyrics.romaji: Kita no Sora Nanatsu no Hoshi Kagayaite
lyrics.en: In the northern sky, seven stars shine
lyrics.zh: 北方的天空，七顆星閃耀

lyrics.ja: いろんなことがあったよね　立ち止まることだって
lyrics.romaji: Ironna Koto ga Atta yo ne Tachidomaru Koto Datte
lyrics.en: So much has happened, hasn't it? Even times we stopped still
lyrics.zh: 發生過好多事呢，也曾停下腳步

lyrics.ja: それに意味があるって　教えてくれたね
lyrics.romaji: Sore ni Imi ga Aru tte Oshiete Kureta ne
lyrics.en: You taught me that even that has meaning
lyrics.zh: 是你教會我那些也有意義

lyrics.ja: ポラリス　旅をする者を　いつも導いて
lyrics.romaji: Porarisu Tabi wo Suru Mono wo Itsumo Michibiite
lyrics.en: Polaris—always guiding those who travel
lyrics.zh: 北極星，總是引導著旅人

lyrics.ja: 私にとって　それが君だって　思うよ
lyrics.romaji: Watashi ni Totte Sore ga Kimi Da tte Omou yo
lyrics.en: To me, I think that's you
lyrics.zh: 對我來說，那個人就是你

lyrics.ja: ポラリス　変わらずにいてね　いつも見守って
lyrics.romaji: Porarisu Kawarazu ni Ite ne Itsumo Mimamotte
lyrics.en: Polaris—stay unchanged, always watching over me
lyrics.zh: 北極星，請永遠不變地守護著我

lyrics.ja: 永遠を信じたいよ　物語
lyrics.romaji: Eien wo Shinjitai yo Monogatari
lyrics.en: I want to believe in eternity—this story
lyrics.zh: 想相信永恆，這個故事

lyrics.ja: 神様がくれた　運命っていう名の story
lyrics.romaji: Kamisama ga Kureta Unmei tte Iu Na no Story
lyrics.en: A story named destiny, given by God
lyrics.zh: 神所賜予的，名為命運的故事

lyrics.ja: はなればなれでも　ひとつのキセキ信じて
lyrics.romaji: Hanarebanare demo Hitotsu no Kiseki Shinjite
lyrics.en: Even when apart, believing in one miracle
lyrics.zh: 即使分隔兩地，仍相信同一個奇蹟

lyrics.ja: 高い空　5つの星　煌めいて
lyrics.romaji: Takai Sora Itsutsu no Hoshi Kirameite
lyrics.en: In the high sky, five stars sparkle
lyrics.zh: 高空中，五顆星閃爍

lyrics.ja: 迷ってばかりの道だって　ずっとね　怖くなかった
lyrics.romaji: Mayotte Bakari no Michi Datte Zutto ne Kowakunakatta
lyrics.en: Even on a road full of wandering, I was never afraid
lyrics.zh: 即使是充滿迷惘的道路，也一直都不害怕

lyrics.ja: そばに君がいたから　勇気をくれたね
lyrics.romaji: Soba ni Kimi ga Ita kara Yuuki wo Kureta ne
lyrics.en: Because you were by my side, you gave me courage
lyrics.zh: 因為有你在身旁，給了我勇氣

lyrics.ja: ソラリス　道標のように　そっと佇んで
lyrics.romaji: Sorarisu Michishirube no You ni Sotto Tatazunde
lyrics.en: Solaris—standing quietly like a guidepost
lyrics.zh: 太陽星，如路標般靜靜佇立

lyrics.ja: 未来をちゃんと　見つけられたんだ　ありがとう
lyrics.romaji: Mirai wo Chanto Mitsukerareta n Da Arigatou
lyrics.en: I was able to find the future properly—thank you
lyrics.zh: 能好好找到未來，謝謝你

lyrics.ja: ソラリス　素直になれるよ　君の言葉で
lyrics.romaji: Sorarisu Sunao ni Nareru yo Kimi no Kotoba de
lyrics.en: Solaris—I can be honest, thanks to your words
lyrics.zh: 太陽星，因你的話語我能變得坦率

lyrics.ja: 続きを描きたいよ　物語
lyrics.romaji: Tsuzuki wo Egakitai yo Monogatari
lyrics.en: I want to draw the continuation—this story
lyrics.zh: 想描繪後續，這個故事

lyrics.ja: Ah　点と点を　繋いで
lyrics.romaji: Ah Ten to Ten wo Tsunaide
lyrics.en: Ah, connecting point to point
lyrics.zh: Ah，將點與點連起

lyrics.ja: あのね　あのね　君のその目を見ると
lyrics.romaji: Ano ne Ano ne Kimi no Sono Me wo Miru to
lyrics.en: You know, you know—when I look into your eyes
lyrics.zh: 那個啊，那個啊，只要看著你的眼睛

lyrics.ja: 明日を信じたいと　そう思えるの
lyrics.romaji: Ashita wo Shinjitai to Sou Omoeru no
lyrics.en: I feel like I want to believe in tomorrow
lyrics.zh: 就覺得想相信明天

lyrics.ja: でもね　でもね　時は過ぎてしまうから
lyrics.romaji: Demo ne Demo ne Toki ha Sugite Shimau kara
lyrics.en: But you know, but you know—time passes by
lyrics.zh: 但是呢，但是呢，時光會流逝

lyrics.ja: 今を刻んで　忘れないでいてずっと
lyrics.romaji: Ima wo Kizande Wasurenaide Ite Zutto
lyrics.en: So carve this moment into your heart and never forget it
lyrics.zh: 銘刻當下，永遠不要忘記
